scope: Read-only bounded #92 application/domain sweep; no repository edits, dependency change, build or browser execution.
inspectedAreas: application route/provider composition and browser/static state boundary
store generic, curated and artist pages

candidates.finding: StorePages.tsx is 813 lines and exports StoreCard/StoreMetadata that three sibling feature consumers import directly. The card is shared by generic, curated and artist views; metadata is also used by isolated Fourthwall preview. A page-composition module therefore owns common presentation dependencies.
candidates.change: Move existing card/badge and metadata presentation to explicit feature-local components, update real consumers, retain identical props/markup and canonical selectors. Keep CSS ownership/import behavior explicit. Do not introduce a generic UI framework or new package.
candidates.benefit: Makes existing component ownership match its actual reuse and lets page composition evolve without sibling consumers depending on the large generic/detail-page module.
preserve: StoreCard optional catalog input and default canonical catalog
existing class names, element hierarchy, accessible copy and locale links
declared artwork order and public visibility
checks: existing StoreDesignOrder, StorefrontPages, StoreArtistPage and FourthwallPreviewPage units
fresh normal + isolated preview build; compare route HTML after normalizing emitted asset filenames and retain any useId differences explicitly
candidates.limit: Structural cohesion improvement; no automatic claim of smaller browser bundle or better measured performance.

candidates.finding: filterStoreEntries calls getEntryContexts, which resolves designs, then separately resolves designs again. getEntryDesigns constructs a full ID Map for each non-design lookup. It resolves all related translated text even for empty queries. Artist pages search the entire catalog and intersect IDs even when no query is present.
candidates.change: Use one per-invocation lookup and reuse each entry's resolved designs for context/search, and/or skip text-search work when normalized terms are empty. Artist no-query view can use its already-validated explicit selection directly. Keep public signatures stable and avoid persistent caches over mutable catalogs.
candidates.benefit: Removes observed repeated work, especially as song/collection count grows, without changing canonical catalog identity or adding a second index lifecycle.
preserve: catalog result order and reference identity
locale-sensitive NFKC/case rules and original creative-title aliases
searching only current reviewed selected/fallback fields
story and type filtering even when query is blank
checks: existing artists, curation and design-order portable tests
add focused whitespace/no-query identity/order coverage if fast path introduced
add mutation-between-calls coverage if any lookup reuse could persist unexpectedly
candidates.limit: Do not weaken validation or invent a persistent memoization contract. Query behavior for malformed direct locale inputs should be consciously preserved or left unchanged; registry-supplied production locales are already validated.

candidates.finding: ContextNotes calls content(context) four times per rendered context, and gallery/copy sections call content(selectedDesign) repeatedly for the same title. Each call canonicalizes locales and builds reviewed-translation lookup maps.
candidates.change: Bind a local presented-context/presented-selected-design value once per render/map iteration, as StoreCard and artist entrance already do. Do not add a global cache.
candidates.benefit: Clearer pairing of each localized value with its locale while avoiding repeated pure resolution.
checks: existing StoreContentLocale, StoreArtworkGallery, StoreDetailPages and CatalogLocalizationJourney units
candidates.limit: No new benchmark claim; simple cleanup can ride with the selected presentation refactor.

keep.area: Schema validation in browser purchase boundary
keep.reason: getStorePurchaseAction intentionally revalidates complete runtime configuration for live handoff. Do not strip Zod or skip readiness checks merely to reduce the current shared payload.
useBrowserSnapshot and AppProviders preserve initial prerender/hydration state before URL/storage controls. No speculative SSR route splitting or new state system justified.
Existing selected-ID fallback, same-source error handling, focus return/body overflow cleanup have relevant tests. No concrete new defect established in read-only inspection.
No contract or data migration needed by the selected maintenance scope.

defer.owner: #92 with #37/#70 visual acceptance and #59 asset provenance if externalized
defer.reason: StoreArtwork repeats substantial SVG geometry in generic catalog/detail SSR. External motif assets or symbols could reduce HTML, but change asset/rendering boundaries and must preserve accessibility, gradients, fallback and artwork provenance. No such rewrite is necessary for the first overnight code cleanup; measure after profile reconciliation.

defer.area: Lazy route splitting or runtime-schema decomposition
defer.reason: Could reduce shared browser payload but adds hydration/preload or validation-boundary risk. Current receipt-based static rendering and purchase guards should remain.
Concrete existing owner; do not duplicate its work in #92.
Old draft #73 must be deliberately reconciled with current code; not part of code sweep.
Already implemented/integrated or retain explicit final acceptance; consume their contracts rather than reopen equivalent rewrites.

verificationLimits: This audit establishes source observations and candidate checks only.
Dependency inventory/security/release verification is delegated separately.
No new license or artwork/product grant inferred; no private source accessed.
